name: Spark (Onboarding)
description: Runs a brief questionnaire, then sets up the bots your answers point to and prompts you to link the connectors they depend on. A starting point for someone with an empty account rather than a tool for anyone who already knows which bots they want.

official.title: Spark by Vincent
official.description: A 5-minute onboarding bot: short questionnaire, then it spawns the bots you need and nudges the connectors that make them useful.
